title: A FRAUD write-off on a loan MARKED CHARGED OFF credits the CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE account 13 with the 750.00 principal and debits the 750.00 total ONCE to LOSSES_WRITTEN_OFF (loan 9 L37)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry a write-off posted on a loan ALREADY MARKED CHARGED OFF and MARKED FRAUD, under createJournalEntriesForWriteOffsWhenLoanIsChargedOff, on the Tier-D MNT write-off replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_DOWNPAYMENT_AUTO_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION / product 20) at the write-off transaction. request.charged_off_write_off_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's write-off transaction id 37 (externalId L37, type loanTransactionType.writeOff, fraud true, chargedOff true): principalPortion 750.0 -> "75000" minor units; interestPortion, feeChargesPortion, penaltyChargesPortion and overpaymentPortion are 0 and are omitted. request.charged_off_write_off_journal.fraud is the loan's observed fraud flag true. request.charged_off_write_off_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_DOWNPAYMENT_AUTO_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION.json: chargeOffExpenseAccountId 18, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 13, incomeFromChargeOffInterestAccountId 20, incomeFromChargeOffFeesAccountId 16, incomeFromChargeOffPenaltyAccountId 16, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 11, writeOffAccountId 19, fundSourceAccountId 5. expect.charged_off_write_off_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L37 legs in id order from the journal-entries read-back: JE 97 CREDIT account 13 750.00, JE 98 DEBIT account 19 750.00. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: on a FRAUD loan the principal slot CREDITS the fraud charge-off expense account 13 rather than the ordinary charge-off expense account 18, and the charged-off write-off still DEBITs the total ONCE to the losses-written-off account. A port that ignores the fraud flag credits account 18 here, so the principal account cell moves. The fund-source debits the processor accumulates are NEVER posted. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a non-zero interest/fee/penalty/overpayment portion — this observation is principal-only; the same-account merge is graded by LN-TD-WO-loan-4-chargedoff-writeoff-merged and the mixed principal+interest posting by LN-TD-WO-loan-7-chargedoff-writeoff-progressive. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
